item.title: North Carolina in 50 Objects
item.description:
North Carolina’s story lives in objects made here, used here, treasured here, and sometimes transformed here. They carry the marks of work and worship, progress and protest, music and memory. Some built industries; others built traditions. A few changed the nation. Together, they tell us who we are, who we’ve been, and what we carry forward.
